name: Sanctuary nurse
design: Petite but muscular mature female Yautja, warm tan finely speckled hide, wide cranium with deep orbital ridges, four gentle partially open mandibular arms, short thick dark tendrils with ceramic beads. Dull indigo short-sleeved care tunic, cream apron with rounded split hem, green belt pouches. Holds a small sealed ceramic ointment jar and soft folded cloth close to her waist. Calm head tilted slightly toward viewer.
